exposure: abnormally adherent placenta (accreta, increta, and percreta)
cohort: Women undergoing emergency peripartum hysterectomy at King Abdulla University Hospital over a 15-year period.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomy was 1.38 per 1000 births, with abnormally adherent placenta being the most common indication (44.06%), and the strongest risk factor for abnormally adherent placenta was placenta previa with previous cesarean section.
